english.title: Landlord of dwelling no longer subject to domestic tenancy check contents / condition of dwelling without licence
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the landlord of a dwelling, namely **(..SPECIFY DWELLING..), that was subject to a domestic tenancy, but was no longer subject to that domestic tenancy, unlawfully checked the contents or condition of the dwelling, or arranged for them to be checked, for a purpose connected with that tenancy when not licensed to do so under Part 1 of the Housing (Wales) Act 2014
english.legislation: Contrary to section 7(3) and (5) of the Housing (Wales) Act 2014.
